title: ReqFlux on Bolt, from DBFlux's app
brief: ReqFlux's main window rebuilt from DBFlux's query editor artboard and real screenshots: activity rail, centered command search, sidebar tree with icons, document toolbar, selector chips with the environment, request line, response with segmented views and bottom bar, status chips. Only the accent (cobalt) and the HTTP content change.

artboards.title: Main window
artboards.tradeoff: Same app as DBFlux; one more stacked row in the document (toolbar plus selector chips) than DBFlux's editor

artboards.title: Workspace menu
artboards.tradeoff: One workspace at a time; switching keeps each workspace's drafts

artboards.title: Workspace settings: environments
artboards.tradeoff: DBFlux settings pattern; environments edited per workspace

artboards.title: Response: sending
artboards.tradeoff: Cancel in Send's place while in flight

artboards.title: Response: error and timeline
artboards.tradeoff: Exact transport error; timeline of the previous send

artboards.title: Audit log
artboards.tradeoff: DBFlux audit timeline; agent actions and your decisions, secrets never logged
